findings.cut: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
findings.reason: Wizard with flash and spell copy; with already present Saw in Half and Essence Flux makes two extra Commander Spellbook combo lines (16→18 included), plus castable two red mana before five-mana Kefka. Adds direct Wizard-copy interaction at Inalla's cEDH ceiling.
findings.loss: Explicitly removed in Oct14 initial 49-card rebuild; costs {1}{R}{R} (RR source constraint); losing Kefka's discard/draw ETB and possible copied trigger. Needs upfront owner disclosure and full approval; prior removal is not an absolute ban.

findings.reason: Oracle permits legal target of any spell or permanent and only counters/destroys when blue, allowing cast for storm/graveyard without existing blue target. Both one red mana.
findings.loss: REB targeting only blue offers greater resilience to retarget-to-nonblue tricks and already covers the primary blue-interaction role. EDHREC cEDH sampled REB 52.8% vs Pyro 36.6%; prevalence is not proof of superiority; gain may be too marginal to qualify.

findings.reason: For two life, zero mana cantrip plus opponent-hand information can help sequence proactive Spellseeker/Breach turn; sorcery cast and graveyard card for Breach. Commander-legal U identity.
findings.loss: Ragavan turn-one combat creates Treasures and card advantage, accelerating critical red/black mana; EDHREC cEDH 67.6% Ragavan vs 24.6% Probe. Cannot claim the trade is favorable without pod composition/opponent blockers.

findings.reason: Guaranteed untapped rainbow on turns 1–3 for life1 each colored activation, independent of enemy lands.
findings.loss: After turn3 enters tapped; Exotic Orchard often rainbow and painless in three-opponent cEDH; neither source statistics nor card Oracle establishes whole-game advantage. Not a free upgrade.

findings.reason: One-mana Djinn Wizard with Inalla {1} copy can self-mill six cards per instant/sorcery cast this turn, helping Breach.
findings.loss: Needs spell follow-up and 1 extra generic; its token expires end step. Blood Pet is immediate sacrificial black body for Culling the Weak, Sacrifice and early turbo; loses reliable existing line resource.

findings.reason: With Dualcaster Mage plus another controlled artifact/creature, can generate infinite Dualcaster tokens; as sorcery it can copy Spellseeker ETB even though tokens don't retrigger Eminence.
findings.loss: Adds redundant combo contingent on unapproved Dualcaster reintroduction; removes low-cost emergency extra-turn tool for proactive combo. Distinctness and slot quality insufficient.

findings.reason: Returns Wizard and untaps up to two lands; could rebuy Spellseeker while yielding tempo in favorable land states.
findings.loss: Can target creatures only; Chain of Vapor also clears noncreature Rule-of-Law/stax pieces and saves Inalla lines at one blue mana, so substitution undermines permission to combo.

findings.reason: Two mana clone copying existing Spellseeker becomes Wizard and can trigger Inalla Eminence.
findings.loss: Requires excellent creature already on battlefield; Trainer's self-contained top-four noncreature/nonland selection is 0.973 on first ETB and duplicable under Eminence, and is an October 14 owner chosen piece.

findings.reason: One black mana can convert lands into extra black for one all-in combo turn.
findings.loss: Sacrifices long-term mana base and at two or three lands can underperform unthresholded Cabal Ritual; loses graveyard-threshold ritual that is core to owner-approved turbo shell.

cut: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
findings.reason: More protection and graveyard tutor pile options; in cEDH adoption is nonzero.
findings.loss: Defense Grid also taxes own off-turn free interaction by three; Gifts four-mana and a new Game Changer; losing Blood Pet impacts sac burst.

gameplan: Command-zone Eminence copies nontoken Wizard ETBs; Spellseeker/Scholar/Burnt Offering/Finale and Bloodline Necromancer/Ruthless Technomancer win lines; backups Thassa's Oracle/Pact and Breach/LED/Brain Freeze. Inalla need not be cast.
constraints: Five material quality-positive swaps MINIMUM for owner presentation; not five arbitrary edits. This pass identifies one relatively strong owner-removed reversal and two debatable follow-up experiments, none forming a five-swap whole-100 improvement. Preserve historical canonical Inalla and 22 preceding M7 locks.
testing_scope: Dry deterministic source-bound audit and focused unit tests of experimental 100-card alternatives, Oracle identities and conditional combo facts. No actual matches, win rates, third-model peer review or new live full API pull.
